name: Abe no Yasuchika
source:
He is one of the strongest onmyoji of the time, and is called the reincarnation of Abe no Seimei. 

He belongs to the Imperial Bureau of Onmyo, and is assisting the shogunate. He is a hard-core weird person, and does not think about anything that is not related to the study of ayakashi and onmyo. He often treats other with a teasing attitude, but his real thoughts are hidden under puzzles.

Organization: Imperial Court, Bureau of Onmyōdō
Interests: Onmyo experimentation, Astrology, ayakashi observation

[From the website character profile.]
